[[Switzerland]] participated at the [[2010 Winter Olympics]] in [[Vancouver]], [[British Columbia]], [[Canada]]. 146 athletes entered 14 sports (all except short track speed skating).

{{TOC limit}}

==Bobsleigh==
{{Main|Bobsleigh at the 2010 Winter Olympics}}
Switzerland qualified three [[Bobsleigh#Sleighs and crews|sleighs]] in the two-man event,<ref>[http://fibt.com/fileadmin/Newsletter_PDFs/Olympic%20Quotas_Final/2-man%20Quotas.pdf FIBT final allocation of the bobsleigh two-man teams for the 2010 Winter Olympics.] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110710235850/http://fibt.com/fileadmin/Newsletter_PDFs/Olympic%20Quotas_Final/2-man%20Quotas.pdf |date=2011-07-10 }}, retrieved on 21 February 2010.</ref> two sleighs in the two-woman event<ref>[http://fibt.com/fileadmin/Newsletter_PDFs/Olympic%20Quotas_Final/Women%27s%20Bobsleigh%20Quotas.pdf FIBT bobsleigh two-woman final quota allocation.] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140103232200/http://fibt.com/fileadmin/Newsletter_PDFs/Olympic%20Quotas_Final/Women%27s%20Bobsleigh%20Quotas.pdf |date=2014-01-03 }}, retrieved 21 February 2010.</ref> and two sleighs in the four-man event.<ref>[http://fibt.com/fileadmin/Newsletter_PDFs/Olympic%20Quotas_Final/4-man%20Quotas.pdf FIBT final quota allocations for bobsleigh four-man at the 2010 Winter Olympics.] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110710235858/http://fibt.com/fileadmin/Newsletter_PDFs/Olympic%20Quotas_Final/4-man%20Quotas.pdf |date=2011-07-10 }}, retrieved 21 February 2010.</ref> Switzerland lost two of its two-man sleighs after driver [[Beat Hefti]] and brakeman [[Jörg Egger]] suffered injuries during the training runs.<ref name="Bobsleigh-injuries">[https://sports.yahoo.com/olympics/news?slug=reu-bobsleightraining_pix&prov=reuters&type=lgns "Bobsleigh-Injuries leave Swiss in disarray."], by Martyn Herman, 19 February 2010, [https://sports.yahoo.com/ Yahoo! Sports], retrieved on 21 February 2010.</ref>

==Freestyle skiing==
{{Main|Freestyle skiing at the 2010 Winter Olympics}}

Switzerland entered 14 athletes into freestyle skiing events, 6 in the aerials and 8 in ski cross.<ref name="freestyle team">[http://www.swissolympic.ch/desktopdefault.aspx/tabid-4072/634023954772131250/?url=%2fzeusclient_Vancouver%2fhome%2fevents.aspx%3flang%3dde%26sdId%3d35%252c24 Swiss Olympic - Freestyle skiing Team] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120225195756/http://www.swissolympic.ch/desktopdefault.aspx/tabid-4072/634023954772131250/?url=%2fzeusclient_Vancouver%2fhome%2fevents.aspx%3flang=de&sdId=35%2c24 |date=2012-02-25 }}, Swiss Olympic Official Site, retrieved on 21 February 2010. '''(German)'''.</ref>
